rationale: The assistant identified the correct cause (clock unset after a power cut) from the very first reply and the customer ultimately set the time and the oven heated, with no parts, no escalation and no safety issues. However, it leaned on generic button labels ('Clock', 'Start', 'OK', 'Menu', 'Settings') that did not match the panel and took three turns to simply ask which buttons were present, and in message 3 asked whether 'any lights or numbers appear on the display' after the customer had already reported flashing 0.00. It repeated the 'turn the function knob to Manual (hand symbol)' instruction in every message, and the closing advice that doing so would prevent the lockout after future power cuts is doubtful, since the clock must be reset regardless.
